obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: the centre line of the impactor shall be within a ± 10 mm tolerance to the selected impact location
obligations.ears: At the time of first contact, the centre line of the impactor shall be within a ± 10 mm tolerance to the selected impact location.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: the impactor shall not contact the ground or any object which is not part of the vehicle
obligations.ears: While the impactor and the vehicle are in contact, the impactor shall not contact the ground or any object which is not part of the vehicle.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.ears: When striking the bumper, the impact velocity of the impactor shall be 11.1 ± 0.2 m/s.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: The effect of gravity shall be taken into account
obligations.ears: When the impact velocity is obtained from measurements taken before the time of first contact, the effect of gravity shall be taken into account.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: The tibia bending moments shall not exceed ± 15 Nm within an evaluation interval of 30 ms immediately prior to impact
obligations.ears: The tibia bending moments shall not exceed ± 15 Nm within an evaluation interval of 30 ms immediately prior to impact.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: The offset compensation shall be done with the flexible lower legform impactor in resting position prior to the test / acceleration phase
obligations.ears: The offset compensation shall be done with the flexible lower legform impactor in resting position prior to the test / acceleration phase.

obligations.response: Each test shall be completed within two hours of when the impactor to be used is removed from the controlled storage area
obligations.ears: When the impactor to be used is removed from the controlled storage area, each test shall be completed within two hours.

obligations.subject: e40
obligations.response: shall be in the bumper test area as defined in paragraph 3.10
obligations.ears: The selected target points shall be in the bumper test area as defined in paragraph 3.10.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: The direction of impact shall be parallel to the longitudinal axis of the vehicle, with the axis of the upper legform vertical at the time of first contact
obligations.ears: The direction of impact shall be parallel to the longitudinal axis of the vehicle, with the axis of the upper legform vertical at the time of first contact.
